answer.description: owner: a policy question, or in doubt; nothing is decided. decision: a build question, decided.

reason.description: owner: what makes the question policy, naming the ADR, rule, scope, security boundary or cost limit an option touches. decision: empty.

decision.description: decision: the record, appended unedited to agister/docs/decisions.md. owner: null.

asked_by.description: Who asked, as the question file states it.

question.description: The question, as the question file states it.

options.description: The options, as the question file states them.

why.description: Why the recorded decisions, or failing them the reasoning stated, exclude it.

rests_on.description: Each recorded decision the answer rests on, as its document and rule or record (ADR-001 rule 9, D-3, agister/AGENTS.md). The one entry "none" when no recorded decision bears on the question.

follow_ups.description: What the decision leaves to do, one per entry. A follow-up that changes code names the test that proves it.
